info.title: pare
info.description: pare: strips TypeScript type syntax to JavaScript. Framework-dependent .NET tool, needs the .NET 10 runtime, no Node. A standalone native binary that needs no .NET is on the GitHub Releases page.

options.name: --outdir
options.description: write output under dir, mirroring the inputs' common directory

options.name: --stdin
options.description: read TypeScript from stdin, write JavaScript to stdout
